title: haven: GroupInfoOption payload carries a length prefix protocol-06 does not define
description: havenmessenger/interop 2c14e62 src/protocol_wire.rs HandshakeBundle::encode writes GroupInfoOption.payload as VLBytes (opaque<V>); its own doc calls this 'a known, disclosed departure from the literal wire shape'. protocol-06 §5.3 L1428-1436: struct { GroupInfoRepresentation representation; select (representation) { case full: GroupInfo groupInfo; case partial: PartialGroupInfo partialGroupInfo; } } GroupInfoOption; no length. mimid decodes GroupInfo directly and fails with EndOfStream on Haven's update bundle. Confirmed: fixture handshake_bundle_commit.bin has 0x41a4 (420) at offset 846 before the 420-byte GroupInfo; with those 2 bytes removed mimid decodes and re-encodes it byte-identically (test haven_fixtures.rs). Report on havenmessenger/interop only with Mark's per-action OK.
